requirements.title: REPEAT argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING shall be a character scalar, NCOPIES shall be an integer scalar, and NCOPIES shall not be negative.

pending.REPEAT-NCOPIES-nonnegative: Positive source controls use zero and positive NCOPIES values; source-control mutation uses -1 without claiming a diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: REPEAT result characteristics
requirements.definition: The REPEAT result is a character scalar with STRING's kind type parameter and length NCOPIES times STRING's length.

pending.REPEAT-result-character-scalar: Assign REPEAT('ab',2) to a character scalar sentinel initialized to 'zzzz' and assert scalar LEN and value; mutation uses an array-valued expected context.
pending.REPEAT-result-kind-same-as-STRING: Guarded plan: probe SELECTED_CHAR_KIND('ISO_10646') for a positive nondefault kind, create a one-character string of that kind, and assert KIND(REPEAT(string,2)) equals KIND(string); companion default-kind string covers ordinary character kind.
pending.REPEAT-result-length-product: Assert LEN(REPEAT('abc',3))==9 and LEN(REPEAT('abc',0))==0, with the NCOPIES=3 companion preventing vacuous zero-length-only coverage.

requirements.title: REPEAT result is repeated concatenation
requirements.definition: The REPEAT result value is the concatenation of NCOPIES copies of STRING.

pending.REPEAT-concatenates-copies: Use STRING='XYZ' and NCOPIES=3; initialize result to a different nine-character sentinel and assert 'XYZXYZXYZ'. Mutation changes NCOPIES or STRING order.
pending.REPEAT-zero-copies-empty-string: Use NCOPIES=0 and assert LEN is zero, paired with NCOPIES=2 producing 'HH' so a blank or unmodified result cannot pass vacuously.
